# komodo_git_provider_account (Resource)

Manages a Komodo git provider account (credentials for accessing git repositories).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "komodo_git_provider_account" "github" {
  domain   = "github.com"
  username = "my-github-user"
  token    = "ghp_…" # use var.* / a secret store in real configs (sensitive)
  https    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Git provider domain without protocol (e.g. 'github.com', 'gitea.example.com'). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Personal access token or password for the git account. Sensitive.
- `username` (String) Git account username. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `https` (Boolean) Whether to access the git provider over HTTPS (true) or HTTP (false).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the git provider account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing git provider account by its Komodo ID.
terraform import komodo_git_provider_account.github 65a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1
```
